whatIs: Omatsuri is a web app with frontend tools that run in your browser: a CSS triangle generator, a gradient generator, a page divider generator, an SVG compressor, an SVG to JSX converter, a Base64 encoder, a fake data generator and a collection of HTML/CSS symbols, among others.
It's a good fit for handling one-off CSS and SVG tasks without installing anything. It's a PWA, so it also works offline.
uses: Generating the CSS for a triangle or a gradient and copying it straight into your project.
Compressing an SVG before uploading it, or converting it to a JSX component.
Creating realistic fake data to fill a mockup or a test database.
caveats: The repository hasn't had changes since February 2026, so don't expect new tools often.
Each tool is simple: for advanced cases, such as an SVG that needs fine-grained optimization, it may fall short.
Everything is processed in your browser, so very large files depend on your machine's capacity.
pricingNote: Open source under the MIT license, with no ads or analytics.
idealFor: Quick CSS and SVG tasks without installing anything.
